companyDescription: Defense comms/cybersecurity microcap · SkyHopper PRO + ICE Electronic Warfare Resistance & Cybersecurity Suite now shipping on a monthly delivery cadence under a $249M, 5-year DoD Program of Record with a Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer, plus new Israeli and Asia-Pacific Tier-1 design wins — debt-free, no active ATM, but H1 2026 net loss widened sharply as opex scaled ahead of revenue
priceNote: Down 3.5% today and trading just 6.9% above the 52-week low ($4.33) — the stock has drifted from $5.14 (Aug 10 report) to $4.63 over seven weeks despite a run of genuinely positive news (Aug 13 H1 results, Aug 5 Israeli Tier-1 design win, Sept 14 Asia-Pacific robotics follow-on order). Nov 12, 2026 Q3 results is the next real test of whether revenue conversion can outrun the sharply widened H1 net loss.
summary: Mobilicom's H1 2026 print (Aug 13) confirmed the DoD Program of Record moved from episodic purchase orders to a monthly delivery cadence — a real structural inflection — and the company has since added an Israeli Tier-1 defense design win (Aug 5) and a follow-on Asia-Pacific robotics order (Sept 14). But H1 revenue grew only 19% YoY to $1.73M while net loss ballooned to $6.69M (from $0.07M in H1 2025) as opex surged to $9.31M — the market's read has been net negative, with the stock drifting from $5.14 to $4.63 (-9.9%) over the seven weeks since that report despite the design-win headlines. Cash fell to $15.08M (Jun 30) from $19.0M (Dec 2025); at the adjusted $591K/month burn that's ~25 months of runway, or ~18 months at the unadjusted $859K/month rate — both clear the 12-month survival bar and no active ATM was found in recent filings, so this is NOT a survival flag, but the burn trend needs to stabilize by Nov 12. catalystType is partnership_win, turbo's weakest bucket (medianExcessVsBenchPct -3.8pp vs +2.0pp lane overall, n=16) — position sized down to 2% (from the prior 3%) to reflect both that headwind and the widened losses, despite the real, converting DoD contract underneath a $60M market cap.

catalysts.name: $249M DoD Program of Record — Now at Monthly Delivery Cadence
catalysts.description: SkyHopper PRO/ICE systems moved from episodic purchase orders to a monthly delivery cadence under the 5-year, $249M program with a Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer selling to the Department of War. Ongoing structural driver behind every quarterly print from here.

catalysts.name: New Design-Win Pipeline (Israel + Asia-Pacific)
catalysts.description: Aug 5 Tier-1 Israeli defense design win (loitering munitions) and Sept 14 follow-on production order from an Asia-based Tier-1 robotics customer — the first real evidence of geographic diversification beyond the single U.S. DoD customer concentration risk.

risks: H1 2026 net loss widened to $6.69M (from just $0.07M in H1 2025) as operating expenses surged to $9.31M against only 19% revenue growth — the widening-loss trend, not the DoD program itself, is what's pressuring the stock; Nov 12 needs to show it stabilizing

Cash fell to $15.08M (Jun 30, 2026) from $19.0M (Dec 2025); runway is ~18-25 months depending on adjusted vs unadjusted burn — comfortably above 12 months and no active ATM was found, but a name this small can't sustain the current burn trajectory indefinitely without either revenue conversion or new financing

catalystType is partnership_win, the weakest bucket in the turbo skill-feedback dataset (medianExcessVsBenchPct -3.8pp vs +2.0pp lane overall, n=16) — design-win headlines have not been reliably converting into sustained re-rates lane-wide
Thin trading liquidity (tens of thousands of dollars in daily volume) means both news and no-news days can produce outsized swings in either direction
Heavy customer concentration — the original Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer relationship remains the single largest revenue driver even as new design wins diversify the pipeline

The Sept 16, 2026 FOMC hike to 3.75-4.00% (unanimous, guidance toward a possible further hike in 2026) raises the broad risk-off backdrop for thinly-traded, unprofitable microcaps independent of MOB's own fundamentals

estimateDates.note: Confirmed per TipRanks — key read is whether the H1 net-loss widening trend is stabilizing as the DoD program's monthly delivery cadence scales

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed actually hiked 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on Sept 16, 2026 (unanimous 12-0), reversing the dovish expectations baked into the Aug report — 16 of 18 policymakers see room for at least one more 25bp hike in 2026. Next FOMC is Oct 28, 2026. DoD program-of-record revenue is appropriations-driven and rate-insensitive, but a thinly-traded microcap like MOB is directly exposed to the broad risk-off tone a hawkish, still-hiking Fed creates.
macroRisk.inflationNote: The Sept 16 hike itself was explicitly justified by inflation remaining elevated above the 2% target — a materially more hawkish read than the 'weak NFP pulling hike odds down' framing from the prior report.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Defense budget allocations remain largely insulated from the rate cycle, but MOB's thin liquidity and $60M market cap make it more sensitive to a genuinely hawkish, still-hiking Fed than the underlying DoD program itself would suggest.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — the Fed hiked (not held) on Sept 16 with guidance toward more hikes, a real shift from the prior report's dovish-leaning read. The DoD program is structurally macro-independent, but MOB's microcap size and thin liquidity mean this raises real risk-off pressure into the Nov 12 print.

MOB's catalystType (partnership_win) is turbo's weakest bucket (-3.8pp median excess vs +2.0pp lane overall, n=16), and H1 net loss widened nearly 100x YoY even as the DoD program converts to real monthly revenue — sized down to 2% to reflect both. catalystSpot.preRunup: Microcap defense names like MOB continue to react sharply to contract/design-win headlines rather than building slowly pre-earnings — five design-win or order announcements since the Aug 13 print (Aug 5 Israeli Tier-1, Aug 17 tariff/onshore alignment, Sept 14 Asia-Pacific robotics follow-on) produced only brief, fading price support.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Days around contract/order announcements, not weeks of positioning
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: Individual headlines have produced single-day pops in the mid-single-digits to +6% range, but have not sustained a re-rate on their own

postWin.note: Kratos Defense (KTOS) ran +380% after its Jan 2026 Marine Corps CCA (Valkyrie) program-of-record win — still the clearest same-sector precedent for what a confirmed DoD program-of-record win can do. MOB's own Aug 13 H1 print (revenue +19% YoY, DoD program moving to monthly delivery cadence) produced a same-week +6.09% pop on 4.5x volume but has since faded to a net -9.9% drift by Sept 29 — the market wants bookings conversion outpacing loss growth, not just design-win headlines, to sustain a re-rate.

postLose.note: No confirmed MOB-specific hard-negative catalyst precedent exists yet, but the post-Aug-13 fade (a +6.09% day-one pop fully reversed and then some within seven weeks) is itself a soft-negative precedent: even a genuinely positive print with real order-flow can't hold a re-rate once net losses widen faster than revenue.

spotSizing.reason: partnership_win is turbo's laggard catalystType (-3.8pp median excess vs +2.0pp lane overall, n=16) and H1 net loss widened nearly 100x YoY ($6.69M vs $0.07M) even as the DoD program converts to real revenue — sized down from the prior report's 3% to reflect both the type-level headwind and the execution risk, despite the debt-free balance sheet and 18-25 month runway

stopPreCatalyst.note: A break below ~$3.33 ahead of Nov 12 earnings would suggest the market is de-risking the order-flow-vs-loss-widening thesis before the print

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Nov 12 results show net losses continuing to widen faster than the DoD program converts to bookings, exit — that is the thesis, not just a stop-loss level

th.summary: ผลประกอบการ H1 2026 ของ Mobilicom (13 ส.ค.) ยืนยันว่าโครงการ DoD Program of Record เปลี่ยนจาก purchase order เป็นๆ ไปๆ สู่การส่งมอบรายเดือนแล้ว — เป็นจุดเปลี่ยนเชิงโครงสร้างจริง และหลังจากนั้นยังได้ design win ใหม่กับลูกค้า defense ระดับ Tier-1 ของอิสราเอล (5 ส.ค.) และออเดอร์ต่อเนื่องจากลูกค้า robotics เอเชีย-แปซิฟิก (14 ก.ย.) แต่รายได้ H1 โตแค่ 19% YoY เป็น $1.73M ขณะที่ขาดทุนสุทธิพุ่งเป็น $6.69M (จาก $0.07M ใน H1 2025) เพราะ opex พุ่งเป็น $9.31M — ตลาดตอบรับเป็นลบสุทธิ หุ้นไหลจาก $5.14 เหลือ $4.63 (-9.9%) ในเจ็ดสัปดาห์ทั้งที่มีข่าวดีต่อเนื่อง เงินสดลดเหลือ $15.08M (30 มิ.ย.) จาก $19.0M (ธ.ค. 2025) ที่ burn rate ปรับปรุงแล้ว $591K/เดือน คิดเป็น runway ~25 เดือน หรือ ~18 เดือนที่ burn ไม่ปรับปรุง $859K/เดือน — ทั้งสองกรณีผ่านเกณฑ์ 12 เดือน และไม่พบ ATM ที่ยัง active ในเอกสารล่าสุด จึงยังไม่ใช่ survival flag แต่แนวโน้ม burn ต้องนิ่งขึ้นภายในผลประกอบการ 12 พ.ย. catalystType คือ partnership_win ซึ่งเป็นกลุ่มที่อ่อนแอที่สุดใน turbo lane (medianExcessVsBenchPct -3.8pp เทียบ +2.0pp โดยรวม, n=16) — size ลงเหลือ 2% (จากเดิม 3%) สะท้อนทั้งจุดอ่อนของประเภท catalyst และขาดทุนที่ขยายตัว แม้จะมีสัญญา DoD จริงที่กำลังแปลงเป็นรายได้อยู่ใต้มูลค่าตลาดแค่ $60M
